game.name: Dead Space
game.desc:
Arcade ice hockey by Mountain Sheep. One-on-one matches with a skater and a goalie a side, played for slapshots and body checks rather than for the rulebook.
This port runs the game's original Android native library directly on Linux through a NativeActivity loader, so no emulator is involved. You supply your own APK - the OUYA build, which is the one made for a controller.
Left stick skates, the face and shoulder buttons shoot and check.
